title: GdTimeMachine Batch Manifest
description: Manifest for GdTimeMachine CLI batch capture. Written by dock, validated before execution.

project_root.description: Absolute path to the Godot project root (validated via git rev-parse).

build_command.description: Generic build hook — opaque shell string. Empty or absent means no build (GDScript-only).

output_dir.description: Default output directory for captures (res:// or absolute path).

obs.description: OBS WebSocket defaults for batch recording.

password_env_var.description: Environment variable name holding the OBS WebSocket password.

captures.description: Ordered list of captures to batch-record. Must be non-empty; labels must be unique and filesystem-safe.

commit.description: Git commit SHA (short or full hex).

scene.description: Scene resource path inside the Godot project.

label.description: Filesystem-safe slug for worktree dir and output file; must be unique within captures.

godot_version_hint.description: Hint for godotenv to resolve the correct Godot binary (e.g. "4.3").

output_path.description: Per-capture output file override; defaults to output_dir/<label>.

build_command.description: Per-entry build_command override. Empty string explicitly skips build for this entry.
